title: Why Is My Teen Suddenly Avoiding Me?
summary: A practical parent guide to reading sudden teen distance without diagnosing it, respecting touch and public-contact boundaries, repairing relational hurts, and keeping a low-pressure route back to connection.
seo_title: Why Is My Teen Avoiding Me? A Parent Guide
seo_description: When your teen avoids hugs, conversation or being seen with you, use the PORCH LIGHT approach to check safety, lower pressure and rebuild connection.
release_move: Give the teenager choice over ordinary touch, public greetings, timing, and communication channel while the parent keeps proportionate safety and household boundaries.

core_belief_shift.from: My teen's distance proves they are ashamed of me, so I must push through the rejection or pull away first.
core_belief_shift.to: Their distance is a signal, not a verdict; I can respect boundaries, check safety, repair my part, and keep connection available.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook is thematically related to peer visibility and adolescent social confidence, but this parent guide stands alone and does not require a product CTA.

hero.alt: A mother and father wait nearby while their teenage daughter talks with two friends outside a school event.
